Auburn University Graduate School continues to update testing requirements by programs as the admissions landscape evolves. Please see the appropriate section below for details (subject to change based on departmental requirements) as well as the program or departmental website to include other admisison requirements, dates and deadlines, etc.
GRE/GMAT Testing
Auburn University Graduate School does not require the GRE; however programs and departments may require official test scores for admission or for consideration of funding. View the program website and/or contact the Graduate Program Officer (GPO) for the program of interest for specific details. A full list of Auburn University graduate programs with GPO contact information can be found on our All Programs page.
To report official test scores from the Graduate Record Exam (GRE) General Test, Auburn University’s ETS institution code is 1005.
To report official test scores from the Graduate Management Admission Test (GMAT) for Management, Finance, Master of Business Administration, and Master of Accountancy programs, please see the codes listed by program below.

Programs Not Waiving Test Scores
Contact the Graduate Program Officer (GPO) for the program of interest for specific details. A full list of Auburn University graduate programs with GPO contact information can be found on our All Programs page.

Special Notes
The Entomology MS, MAg and PhD programs do not require the GRE, but do leave the overall requirement up to the individual Principal Investigator.
While the GRE is required as an evaluation tool, the Mechanical Engineering MS and PhD programs will use flexibility regarding submission deadline, conditional admission, and cut-off limits.
The GMAT is not required for applicants to the Accountancy Online MAcc. The GMAT is optional but recommended for AU undergraduates for the on-campus MAcc program, and required for non-AU students.
The Full-Time MBA, Online MBA, MS Finance, MS Information Systems, and MS Supply Chain Management programs will waive the GMAT/GRE test score requirement for applicants that meet established criteria. Please visit the program pages on The Harbert College of Business website for more information.
The Executive MBA, Physicians Executive MBA and Master of Real Estate Development programs do not require the GMAT.
For specific questions regarding your program of interest, contact the Graduate Program Officer (GPO). A full list of Auburn University graduate programs with GPO contact information can be found on our All Programs page.
